method: Web search/open fallback after native current-source fetch

observations.finding: The current MSU oncology master exposed five named clinical-trial links; four treatment protocol pages were separately opened during protocol fallback.
The newly posted Penn proton FLASH plus gilvetmab metastatic osteosarcoma protocol was opened directly; held index/master routes were not bypassed.
The official Aurelius page states that its fully funded B-cell lymphoma study is actively recruiting.
The exact permitted HDR-HBRT DOCX did not yield readable current content; the held oncology master was not bypassed.
Reader shells were insufficient; both official public JSON pages succeeded natively and were reconciled as 859 records, 58 recruiting oncology.
Exact saved access restrictions were honored. No institution-wide prohibition was inferred from URL-specific restrictions.
